instruction:
Open the native Altium project `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\project.PrjPcb` in Altium Designer. Using `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\add_list.csv`, append 8 new source-document entries to the project and save the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\project.PrjPcb`.

Requirements:
- Preserve the original `[Design]` and `[Preferences]` sections unchanged.
- Preserve the existing `[Document1]` through `[Document6]` sections unchanged.
- Append 8 new document sections in CSV order so the project ends with `[Document7]` through `[Document14]`.
- For each appended document section, set `DocumentPath`, `AnnotationEnabled`, `AnnotateStartValue`, and `ClassGenCCAutoEnabled` exactly as specified by the corresponding row in `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\add_list.csv`.
- Do not create any extra `[Document*]` sections beyond `Document1..Document14`.
